summary: Makes a panel drag-to-move, optionally clamped to its parent.
overview: Drop it on a panel, or on a title-bar child, to make it movable — for repositionable HUD elements and floating debug windows.
useCases: A debug or inspector window the developer can move.
HUD elements the player can reposition.

params.tuning: Defaults to this object's own RectTransform. Set it to the panel root when the component lives on a title bar.
Off, a panel can be dragged completely off screen and become unreachable.

gotchas.title: Dragging fights a layout group
gotchas.body: A panel under a layout group has its position overwritten every rebuild. Drag panels that are not laid out.
